description: This file implements a webhook-based token authenticator for Kubernetes, providing functions and classes to perform token reviews via HTTP webhooks, including client setup, request handling, and response processing.

classes.name: WebhookTokenAuthenticator
classes.description: A struct implementing token authentication via HTTP webhook, handling token review requests and responses.

methods.name: DefaultRetryBackoff
methods.description: Returns default backoff parameters for webhook retries.

methods.name: NewFromInterface
methods.description: Creates a WebhookTokenAuthenticator using a provided token review client interface.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a WebhookTokenAuthenticator from a REST config, specifying API version and retry backoff.

methods.name: newWithBackoff
methods.description: Internal function to instantiate WebhookTokenAuthenticator with specific parameters, used for testing.

methods.name: AuthenticateToken
methods.description: Implements token authentication by sending token review requests via webhook, handling audience validation and response parsing.

methods.name: tokenReviewInterfaceFromConfig
methods.description: Builds a token review client interface from a kubeconfig REST configuration, supporting different API versions.
